Name: Better Grass
Author: VvVvVvV2222222222
Description:
This mod will change your grass to a different version.

- The Recolor adds more color variation to the standard grass.
- The Floral adds flowers to the grass and adds a little height variation.
- Floral B-side is the same as the Floral, but it changes the texture at the bottom to make it a little more realistic looking.


Just add the mod to the mods folder in your game.
You can change the grass type in the config file or you can use the Generic Mod Confic Menu.

I've added a Starblue Version!
It works pretty much the same, but you have to use the Generic Mod Confic Menu to turn of the grass from Starblue's own mod or just change the confic file to do the same. Otherwise it loads both images at once. (Unless you like that of course.)

Only sample images of the Starblue floral and recolor, because B-side does the same as regular version: just adds ragged edges on the bottom of the floral grass.
